people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
translations.bsb: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
translations.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
translations.asv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
